Headline: Orange Line Delays
ShortDescription:
Orange trains are running with residual delays following earlier track conditions near Midway. 

Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Orange trains are running with residual delays following earlier track conditions near Midway. 

Shuttle buses are available between Pulaski and Midway to provide connecting service through the affected area.

Trains in both directions will operate on the same track between Pulaski and Midway, resulting in minor delays. 

Board/exit all trains on the Midway-bound side on the platform at the Pulaski station.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #21 Cermak Temporary Reroute at Cermak/58th Avenue
ShortDescription: #21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, police activity near Cermak/58th Avenue.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#21 Cermak buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Cermak, Austin, 16th, Central, and Cermak then resume their normal route, due to police activity near Cermak/58th Avenue.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #95 95th  Temporary Eastbound Reroute near 95th/Throop
ShortDescription: Eastbound #95 95th buses are temporarily rerouted due to, street blockage near 95th/Throop.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #95 95th buses are temporarily rerouted via 95th, Ashland, Beverly, 99th, Vincennes and 95th due to, street blockage near 95th/Throop.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Red Line Service Delayed at Argyle
ShortDescription: Red Line trains are standing at Argyle due to fire department activity. Crews are working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red Line trains are standing at Argyle due to fire department activity.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
